derivation: from a compound of G3598 (ὁδός) and G4198 (πορεύομαι);
def: to be a wayfarer, i.e. travel

occurrences.text: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
